name: Target Williamsport
address: 170 S Lycoming Mall Rd, Muncy, PA 17756
notes: Vendor-stocked: the cards belong to the vendor (Excell Brands lists Target). No published schedule; each Target gets its own weekday vendor visit, usually around opening. Limits are set company-wide, often 1-2 per item. Target.com drops mostly land 3-6am ET.

name: Pokémon Center (online)
notes: Drops on weekdays only; in 2026 every logged drop opened between 10am and 1:15pm ET, most often in the 11am hour. No published schedule.
